components.title: Site storage
components.description: The encrypted storage class for workspaces and service data (Longhorn reference class).

control-implementations.description: What the rendered storage releases, the site install and the escrow tools show.

statements.description: Every storage class the site stack renders is a Longhorn class with encryption on, using the longhorn-crypto key to provision, publish, stage and expand volumes; the site install makes that key, of at least 256 random bits, before the storage class, passes it on standard input only, never replaces an existing one, and refuses a stored key shorter than a generated one.
statements.remarks: Your organization keeps the escrow copy of the volume encryption key.

implemented-requirements.description: Volumes and their key are backed up.

statements.description: The site's storage class keeps volumes after release and runs a daily snapshot and a daily backup job. The volume encryption key is exported for escrow as a 0600 file with a record that holds one digest per key over its decoded value, and the escrow check fails once the key in the cluster changes; the export never prints a key or passes one as a command argument.
statements.remarks: Your organization stores the escrow copy off the site, under its own custody rules, and tests restores.
